# Terara Printers

> Commercial offset, digital, large-format, branding, and packaging printing company in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

Last updated: 2026-05-14
Primary domain: https://test1-eight-livid.vercel.app/
Contact: teraramarketing@gmail.com

## Overview

Terara Printers serves businesses, schools, publishers, agencies, event teams, retailers, and public institutions that need reliable printed materials in Addis Ababa and across Ethiopia. The company helps clients choose the right print method, stock, finishing, quantity, and production schedule before work begins.

## Core Services

- [Offset Printing](https://test1-eight-livid.vercel.app/services/offset-printing.html): High-volume books, magazines, catalogs, brochures, labels, reports, and recurring brand materials.
- [Digital Printing](https://test1-eight-livid.vercel.app/services/digital-printing.html): Short-run brochures, manuals, booklets, presentations, urgent updates, and variable-data print jobs.
- [Books Printing](https://test1-eight-livid.vercel.app/services/books-printing.html): Textbooks, manuals, reference books, reports, and publishing projects with binding support.
- [Magazine Printing](https://test1-eight-livid.vercel.app/services/magazine-printing.html): Editorial, corporate, institutional, and image-heavy publications with consistent color and finishing.
- [Notebook Printing](https://test1-eight-livid.vercel.app/services/notebook-printing.html): School, institutional, training, and branded notebooks.
- [Brochure Printing](https://test1-eight-livid.vercel.app/services/brochure-printing.html): Product brochures, campaign literature, corporate profiles, folded leaflets, and sales materials.
- [Flyer Printing](https://test1-eight-livid.vercel.app/services/flyer-printing.html): Promotional flyers, event handouts, product launch sheets, public notices, and campaign materials.
- [Short-Run Printing](https://test1-eight-livid.vercel.app/services/short-run-printing.html): Low-quantity print jobs, personalized materials, test batches, and frequently updated documents.
- [Large Format and Specialty Printing](https://test1-eight-livid.vercel.app/services/large-format-specialty.html): Banners, posters, signs, displays, and wall graphics.
- [Business Stationery](https://test1-eight-livid.vercel.app/services/business-stationery.html): Business cards, letterheads, envelopes, notepads, and daily office materials.
- [Custom Packaging](https://test1-eight-livid.vercel.app/services/custom-packaging.html): Product boxes, labels, stickers, branded bags, and retail packaging.
- [Promotional Products](https://test1-eight-livid.vercel.app/services/promotional-products.html): Branded giveaway and corporate gift materials.
- [Marketing and Brand Collateral](https://test1-eight-livid.vercel.app/services/marketing-brand-collateral.html): Brochures, flyers, postcards, catalogs, and campaign print systems.
- [Event Materials](https://test1-eight-livid.vercel.app/services/event-materials.html): Invitations, programs, menus, badges, table tents, and branded event assets.

## Capabilities

- File preflight checks for bleed, margins, image quality, color setup, page order, and production safety.
- Stock guidance for bond, coated paper, cover stock, board, label material, and specialty uses.
- Finishing support for trimming, folding, lamination, UV coating, saddle stitching, perfect binding, spiral binding, die cutting, and packaging preparation.
- Repeat-order specification control for recurring reports, magazines, books, stationery, campaigns, and branded materials.
- Rush production review for qualifying digital and short-run jobs when capacity allows.

## Technical Notes

- Typical stock range: 80 gsm bond through 350 gsm board, depending on project type and material availability.
- Color workflow: CMYK production with Pantone matching support when required by the job.
- Typical digital turnaround: 24 to 72 hours for qualifying short-run jobs after approved files and specifications.
- Typical offset turnaround: approximately 5 to 7 business days after approved files, depending on quantity, stock, finishing, and current production schedule.
- Equipment: commercial production systems for offset, digital, large-format, binding, trimming, and finishing work. Exact press model details are available on request.

## Location

- Address: 4 Killo, Dink Sira Tower, 1st Floor, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
- Primary service area: Addis Ababa, including 4 Kilo, Bole, Piassa, Kazanchis, and Megenagna.
- Wider coverage: print coordination for clients in major Ethiopian cities when pickup or delivery planning is arranged.
